blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A 30-year-old drug suspect who skipped his court hearings is back behind bars after he was collared by a joint police operation in Valencia City, Bukidnon, on Tuesday morning. Authorities arrested Junley Perez Aballe at 9:40 a.m. at his residence in Purok 10, Barangay Lurogan. They arrested Perez on the strength of a warrant issued Friday last week for his failure to appear in court regarding two counts of alleged violation of Sections 5 and 11 of the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act (RA 9165).
